caveats: Node origins are RSYC tile-province intersection centroids, not actual harvest blocks, cutblocks, millsheds, or observed truck trip origins. Within-tile harvest heterogeneity remains.
RSYC production weights are open model estimates of age-100 standing volume, not observed annual harvest. The 119 Mm3 provincial control total is a planning case, not a legal AAC.
The assignment is unchanged: v9 facility targets and volumes are retained. Node-origin volumes are a weighted re-origin of the same assignment, not a new allocation or optimization.
Node-weighted local capacity is an expected accessibility measure that double-counts facilities across nodes. It is not an additional capacity stock and not a siting constraint.

Road distances use documented province factors and a paired OSRM demo sample. OSRM endpoint snaps, resource roads, winter roads, ferries, weight limits, and log-truck restrictions are not validated; routed distances omit the off-road connector.
OSRM may route through the United States where that is the shortest road path; no border delay or customs cost is modelled.
This is a model-estimate screening artifact. It is not a national statistic, national average, policy recommendation, official OSeCAN result, UI product, or greenfield optimization.

centroid_bias.remaining_bias_note: The centroid-origin result is the measured bias baseline. Node-origin recomputation removes that measured province-centroid bias by construction, but does not remove within-tile harvest heterogeneity, road-factor transfer error, or off-road connector error. The OSRM paired sample quantifies the road-factor transfer and endpoint-snap uncertainty.

facility_road_distance_audit_v2_sample.role: paired centroid OSRM sample for node re-origin

national_facility_capacity_v3.role: eligible facility coordinates, class and capacity

rsyc_tile_production_library.role: node production weight and RSYC age-100 volume

tile_ecodistrict_province_weights.role: tile x ecodistrict x province area crosswalk

method.area_weight: SCANFI forest area allocated from ecodistrict-province totals to tile-province cells in proportion to tile ecodistrict intersection area; transparency and sensitivity weight only
method.artifact_role: replace province-centroid origins with open RSYC harvest supply nodes and recompute screening distances, bands, transport cost and local-capacity access without changing the v9 assignment
method.assignment_basis: v9 province_capacity_floor assignment; facility targets and assigned volumes are unchanged. Node-origin volume is the row volume times the origin-province node weight.
method.capacity_access: same-province eligible capacity of the assigned facility class within 50/150/300 km; node capacity is the harvest-weighted expectation across nodes and therefore double-counts facilities across nodes by design
method.distance_basis: haversine from node or province centroid to eligible facility coordinate, multiplied by the facility-province road factor from facility_road_distance_audit_v2
method.fallback_handling: RSYC district-fallback area with no province intersection is excluded from node production and renormalised within province; it is not given a fabricated location
method.harvest_allocation: 119 Mm3 provincial harvest x node production weight; province totals are preserved and no node is assigned volume outside its province
method.node_basis: RSYC 150-km tile x province cell with a geographic province intersection; node location is the tile-province intersection centroid (representative point when the centroid is outside)
method.node_weight: RSYC age-100 standing volume (m3/ha at age 100 times the geographically located part of the tile-province cell), normalised within province
method.osrm_sample: audit-v2 81-pair facility sample re-originated at the highest-weight node of each origin province; paired against the audit-v2 centroid routes; public OSRM demo at 1.2 s spacing, no paid key
method.transport_cost: transport_cost_v1 base curve at 52.5 m3 payload and empty return, applied to each centroid or node distance

osrm_sample.usage_policy: Public OSRM demo server, best-effort; one request at a time with 1.2 s spacing. No paid API key.
